summary: Which non-OPEC producers are increasing output? A group of OPEC countries announced a crude oil production cut stating in May 2023. Together with a continuation of a Russian production cutback of 500 Kb/d, the total reduction could amount to 1.6 Mb/d, if implemented fully.
